release_notes:
Version 1.2.0:

New Features:
- Staff login system with 4-digit PIN authentication
- Role-based staff permissions with 19 granular permission keys
- First-run setup wizard (6 steps: Admin PIN, Staff, Port, Store Info, Gmail, Recovery Token)
- PIN recovery system with one-time-use secure tokens
- Universal session timeout with auto-logout
- Image upload/URL/search for product management
- Mobile responsive design with hamburger menu and 44x44px touch targets
- Desktop shortcut auto-creation on install
- Distributor management system
- Database reset and delete options in system settings
- Backup modals integrated into settings page

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Add Category and Add Set Name buttons on product management page
- Fixed image upload/URL/search fields missing from Add/Edit Product modals
- Fixed setup wizard skipping steps after Admin PIN creation
- Fixed recovery token generation during setup wizard
- Fixed session timeout CSS alignment in system settings
- Fixed backup and import buttons on settings backups page

Improvements:
- All audit log actions now tracked by logged-in staff member name
- Settings page reorganized with permission-gated sections
- Login page shows session expired message on timeout
- Recovery page accessible without authentication
- Migration scripts for all database schema changes
